localScope111: Carts in this context on this computer. Indicators follow the filters.
priceNote111: Values from the loaded catalog. Resuming does not confirm a sale, payment or stock; the server checks at completion.
completedNote111: This cart has already been completed and cannot be resumed here.
changed111: The cart or catalog changed. Review the values again.
ack111: I checked the items, quantities and loaded prices before resuming.
resumeFailed111: The cart could not be resumed. It was preserved; review and try again.
resumed111: Cart sent to the sale workspace. The sale still needs to be completed.
